summary: Created test_p32_t5_t2_t4_same_day_composition.py in back/tests/ with 13 deterministic tests validating same-day T2/T4 composition in multi-day simulation. All acceptance criteria met: multi-day runs (3 days) with qualifying confrontation events, relationship bounds checked, residual kind distinctness verified, carryover across days confirmed, composition_audit_out collision recording tested, state/growth bounds validated, and T2-before-T4 ordering confirmed via upper-boundary clamping. All 914 existing tests continue to pass.
diff_summary:
Added new file back/tests/test_p32_t5_t2_t4_same_day_composition.py with 13 tests covering:
1. test_multiday_simulation_no_exception_with_qualifying_events — 3-day run, confrontation every day, no exception
2. test_relationship_trust_and_closeness_within_bounds_on_collision_day — trust/closeness in [0,100] on single collision day
3. test_multiday_relationship_bounds_maintained_across_3_days — bounds across all 3 days
4. test_t2_and_t4_residuals_are_distinct_entries_with_correct_kinds — T2 creates influencer residual, T4 creates relational residual (Phase 26B bootstrap)
5. test_t4_bootstrap_residual_tagged_relational_with_target_id — Phase 26B seed has kind=relational, target_id=vega-001
6. test_residuals_from_day_n_are_carried_into_day_n1 — day-1 seed enables _adjust_t4 on day-2, wake chain gate opens
7. test_residual_days_remaining_decremented_across_days — carried residual steps from days_remaining=2 to 1
8. test_composition_audit_records_collision_on_confrontation_day — collision_detected=True in audit
9. test_composition_audit_records_collision_across_all_3_days — collision on every day
10. test_all_state_bounds_maintained_after_3_day_composition — mood, stress, energy, all growth dims in [0,100]
11. test_t2_applied_before_t4_within_same_day — trust=100 boundary reveals T2-first order gives trust=98
12. test_t2_closeness_applied_before_t4_closeness — closeness=100 boundary gives closeness=99
13. test_wake_chain_residual_on_day2_is_relational_kind — day-2 wake-chain residual is ResidualKind.relational with negative valence
